messages:
elinor: mid-shift async check — ran a priming pass for microqueue slotting earlier. p50/p95 improved for 2s contexts but one host showed p99 spikes. blocker: can't repro slot-steal locally. today: follow up on sandbox repro + try small KV TTL change. quick log snippet:
``
[2026-03-20T09:12:14Z] slot_assigner: primed slots=3200 warm=0.82 evict_rate=0.07
[2026-03-20T09:12:18Z] kernel: batch_target=8 prefetch=on p95=380ms p99=1.2s
```

sam: saw same p99 on ci-17 yesterday during soak. which host did you hit? can you paste kernel config? pinging @kai to eyeball batcher configs.

kai: on it. which batch_target are we testing? my hunch: bumping to 12-16 lowers p99 at cost of a bit higher p50.

elinor: current is `batch_target=8`, `auto_prefetch=true`. PR for the prefetch tweak is #1421 (small change to prefetch window). repro command: `./tools/prime --clients 50 --seq 512 --warmup 60` — that reliably triggers the slot churn on canary for me.

mira: I can run the repro on cluster-canary-3. also thinking to try KV TTL 60s -> 120s for warmup to reduce evictions during steady priming. low risk.

jordan: +1 to increasing KV TTL in canary. last week we saw eviction storms when many clients hit cold prefixes. would also like an `evict_rate` metric broken down by shard.

ops-bot: deployment: canary run started for elinor/pr-1421 on cluster-canary-3 — watchers: eng-runtime, eng-sre

sam: perf numbers to note: baseline p95 ~480ms for 2s context, after prefetch tweak p95 ~380ms; p99 still noisy (~1.1–1.3s). if canary is clean i'll queue cluster-beta roll.

elinor: blocker: need a linux perf trace from the noisy host to see syscall stalls. @kai can you grab perf or should I spin a flame graph?

kai: i'll collect perf on that host, `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 60`, then `perf script | ./stackcollapse.pl` — should have a dump in ~30m. will also try `batch_target=12` in a follow-up PR to compare.

mira: canary started, running the prime script now. will post p50/p95/p99 in ~15m. :eyes:

sam: if canary looks good, i'll schedule a controlled roll and leave an alert override in Console (low priority until rollout completes).

elinor: thanks — main action items: kai collects perf + opens small batch_target PR, mira posts canary numbers, i'll try the KV TTL bump in a canary patch. tagging this thread for follow-up later. :thumbsup:
